verses.text_uthmani: طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: Ta Sin These are the verses of the Quran––a scripture that makes things clear;
Taa Seen. yeh aayat hain Quran aur kitaab e mubeen ki

verses.text_uthmani: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: a guide and joyful news for the believers
Hidayat aur basharat un iman laney walon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

translations.text: who keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and believe firmly in the life to come.
Jo namaz qayam karte aur zakat detey hain, aur phir woh aisey log hain jo aakhirat par poora yaqeen rakhte hain

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

translations.text: As for those who do not believe in the life to come, We have made their deeds seem alluring to them, so they wander blindly:
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo log aakhirat ko nahin maante unke liye humne unke kartooton ko khushnuma bana diya hai, isliye woh bhatakte phir rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ

translations.text: it is they who will have the worst suffering, and will be the ones to lose most in the life to come.
Yeh woh log hain jinke liye buri saza hai aur aakhirat mein yahi sabse zyada khasare (nuksaan) mein rehne waley hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

translations.text: You [Prophet] receive the Quran from One who is all wise, all knowing.
Aur (aey Muhammad) bila shubah tum yeh Quran ek hakeem o aleem (All-wise and All-knowing) hasti ki taraf se paa rahey ho

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

translations.text: Moses said to his family, ‘I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or a burning stick for you to warm yourselves.’

(Inhein us waqt ka qissa sunao) jab Moosa ne apne ghar walon se kaha ke “mujhey ek aag si nazar aayi hai, main abhi ya to wahan se koi khabar lekar aata hoon ya koi angara chun laata hoon taa-ke tum log garam ho sako”

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: When he reached the fire, a voice called: ‘Blessed is the person near this fireand those around it; may God be exalted, the Lord of the Worlds.
Wahan jo pahuncha to nidaa (awaaz/pukaar) aayi ke “mubarak hai woh jo is aag mein hai aur jo iske maahol mein hai, paak hai Allah sab jahanon ka parwardigar

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

translations.text: Moses, I am God, the Mighty, the Wise.
Aey Moosa, yeh main hoon Allah, zabardast aur daana(All-Wise)

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.text: Throw down your staff,’ but when he saw it moving like a snake, he turned and fled. ‘Moses, do not be afraid! The messengers need have no fear in My presence,

Aur phenk tu zara apni laathi.” Junhi ke Moosa ne dekha laathi saanp(snake) ki tarah bal kha rahi hai to peeth phair kar bhaaga aur peechey mudh kar bhi na dekha. “Aey Moosa, daro nahin, mere huzur Rasool dara nahin karte

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.text: I am truly most forgiving and merciful to those who do wrong,and then replace their evil with good.
Illa yeh ke kisi ne kasoor kiya ho. Phir agar burayi ke baad usne bhalayi se apne fail (amal) ko badal liya to main maaf karne wala meharbaan hoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَـٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

translations.text: Put your hand inside your cloak and it will come out white, but unharmed. These are among the nine signs that you will show Pharaoh and his people; they have really gone too far.’

Aur zara apna haath apne girebaan mein to daalo chamakta hua niklega bagair kisi takleef ke, yeh (dono nishaniyan) naw (nine) nishaniyon mein se hain Firoun aur uske qaum ki taraf (le janey ke liye), woh baday badh-kirdaar(wicked) log hain”

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: But when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, ‘This is clearly [just] sorcery!’
Magar jab hamari khuli khuli nihsaniyan un logon ke samney aayi to unhon ne kaha yeh to khula jaadu hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

translations.text: They denied them, in their wickedness and their pride, even though their souls acknowledged them as true. See how those who spread corruption met their end!
Unhon ne sara-sar zulm aur guroor ki raah se in nishaniyon ka inkar kiya, halaanke dil unke qayel (convinced) ho chuke thay. Ab dekhlo ke un mufsidon ka anjaam kaisa hua

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ عِلْمًا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: We gave knowledge to David and Solomon, and they both said, ‘Praise be to God, who has favoured us over many of His believing servants.’
(Dusri taraf) humne Dawood o Sulaiman ko ilm ata kiya aur unhon ne kaha ke shukar hai us khuda ka jisne humko apne bahut se momin bandon par fazilat ata ki

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

translations.text: Solomon succeeded David. He said, ‘People, we have been taught the speech of birds, and we have been given a share of everything: this is a clearly a great favour.’
Aur Dawood ka waris sulaiman hua aur usne kaha “logon, humein parindon (birds) ki boliyan sikhayi gayi hain aur humein har tarah ki cheezein di gayi hain, beshak yeh (Allah ka) numaya fazl hai.”

verses.text_uthmani: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

translations.text: Solomon’s hosts of jinn, men, and birds were marshalled in ordered ranks before him,
Sulaiman ke liye Jinn aur Insano aur parindon ke lashkar jama kiye gaye thay aur woh puray zabt (strict discipline) mein rakkhey jatey thay

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَـٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.text: and when they came to the Valley of the Ants, one ant said, ‘Ants! Go into your homes, in case Solomon and his hosts unwittingly crush you.’

Ek martaba woh unke saath kooch (marching) kar raha tha) yahan tak ke jab yeh sab chuntiyon (ants) ki waadi(valley) mein pahunchey to ek chunti (ant) ne kaha “ Aey chunityon , Apne bilon (holes) mein ghuss jao, kahin aisa na ho ke Sulaiman aur uske lashkar tumhein kuchal daalein aur unhein khabar bhi na ho”

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

translations.text: Solomon smiled broadly at her words and said, ‘Lord, inspire me to be thankful for the blessings You have granted me and my parents, and to do good deeds that please You; admit me by Your grace into the ranks of Your righteous servants.’

Sulaiman uski baat par muskurate huey hass pada aur bola “aey mere Rubb mujhey qaabu mein rakh ke main tere us ehsan ka shukar ada karta rahoon jo tu-nay mujhpar aur mere walidain par kiya hai aur aisa amal e saleh karoon jo tujhey pasand aaye, aur apni rehmat se mujhko apne saleh bandon mein daakhil kar.”

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ

translations.text: Solomon inspected the birds and said, ‘Why do I not see the hoopoe? Is he absent?
(Ek aur mauqe par) Sulaiman ne parindon ka jaiza liya aur kaha “ kya baat hai ke main falaan hud-hud (hoopoe bird) ko nahin dekh raha hoon. Kya woh kahin gayab ho gaya hai

verses.text_uthmani: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: I will punish him severely, or kill him, unless he brings me a convincing excuse for his absence.’
Main usey sakht saza dunga, ya zubaa kardunga, warna usey mere saamne maaqool wajah pesh karni hogi

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ

translations.text: But the hoopoe did not stay away long: he came and said, ‘I have learned something you did not know: I come to you from Sheba with firm news.
Kuch zyada dair na guzri thi ke usne aakar kaha “maine woh maalumaat haasil ki hai jo aapke ilam mein nahin hain. Main Saba ke mutaalik yaqeeni ittila lekar aaya hoon

verses.text_uthmani: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ

translations.text: I found a woman ruling over the people, who has been given a share of everything- she has a magnificent throne-
Maine wahan ek aurat dekhi jo us qaum ki hukmaran hai. Usko har tarah ka saaz o samaan baksha gaya hai aur uska takht (throne) bada azeem o shaan hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: [but] I found that she and her people worshipped the sun instead of God. Satan has made their deeds seem alluring to them, and diverted them from the right path: they cannot find the right path.

Maine dekha hai ke woh aur uski qaum Allah ke bajaye Suraj ke aagey sajda karti hai” Shaytaan ne unke aamaal unke liye khushnuma bana diye aur unhein shahraah se rok diya, is waja se woh yeh seedha raasta nahin paatey

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ

translations.text: Should they not worship God, who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and earth and knows both what you people conceal and what you declare?
Ke us khuda ko sajda karein jo aasmano aur zameen ki posheeda(hidden) cheezein nikalta hai aur woh sab kuch jaanta hai jisey tum log chupate ho aur zaahir karte ho

verses.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩

translations.text: He is God, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the mighty throne.’
Allah, ke jiske siwa koi mustahiq e Ibadat(worthy of worship) nahin, jo arsh e azeem ka maalik hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

translations.text: Solomon said, ‘We shall see whether you are telling the truth or lying.
Sulaiman ne kaha “abhi hum dekhe letay hain ke tu nay sach kaha hai ye tu jhoot bolne walon mein se hai

verses.text_uthmani: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَـٰبِى هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.text: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then withdraw and see what answer they send back.’
Mera yeh khat (letter) le ja aur usey un logon ki taraf daal de, phir alag hatt kar dekh ke woh kya radd-e-amal zaahir karte hain”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَتْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَـٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ

translations.text: The Queen of Sheba said, ‘Counsellors, a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
Malika boli “aey ehle darbaar, meri taraf ek bada eham khat phenka gaya hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

translations.text: It is from Solomon, and it says, “In the name of God, the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy,
Woh Sulaiman ki janib se hai aur Allah rehman o raheem ke naam se shuru kiya gaya hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: do not put yourselves above me, and come to me in submission to God.”’
Mazmoon yeh hai ke “ mere muqable mein sarkashi na karo aur muslim ho kar mere paas haazir ho jao”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَتْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ

translations.text: She said, ‘Counsellors, give me your counsel in the matter I now face: I only ever decide on matters in your presence.’
(khat sunakar) Malika ne kaha “aey sardaran e qaum mere is maamle mein mujhey mashwara do. Main kisi maamle ka faisla tumhare bagair nahin karti hoon”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ

translations.text: They replied, ‘We possess great force and power in war, but you are in command, so consider what orders to give us.’
Unhon ne jawab diya “hum taqatwar aur ladne waley log hain, aagey faisla aap ke haath mein hai, aap khud dekh lein ke aapko kya hukum dena hai”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

translations.text: She said, ‘Whenever kings go into a city, they ruin it and humiliate its leaders- that is what they do-
Malika ne kaha ke “Baadshah jab kisi mulk mein ghus aate hain to usey kharab aur uske izzat walon ko zaleel kar detay hain, yahi kuch woh kiya karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.text: but I am going to send them a gift, then see what answer my envoys bring back.’
Main in logon ki taraf ek hadiya(gift) bhejti hoon, phir dekhti hoon ke mere elchi (envoy) kya jawaab lekar palat-te hain”

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ

translations.text: When her envoy came to Solomon, Solomon said, ‘What! Are you offering me wealth? What God has given me is better than what He has given you, though you rejoice in this gift of yours.

Jab woh [Malika ka safeer(envoy)] Sulaiman ke haan pahuncha to usne kaha, “ kya tum log maal se meri madad karna chahte ho? Jo kuch khuda ne mujhey de rakkha hai woh issey bahut zyada hai jo tumhein diya hai. Tumhara hadiya (gifts) tumhi ko mubarak rahey

verses.text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَـٰغِرُونَ

translations.text: Go back to your people: we shall certainly come upon them with irresistible forces, and drive them, disgraced and humbled, from their land.’

aey safeer (envoy)]wapas jaa apne bhejne walon ki taraf, hum unpar aisey lashkar lekar aayenge jinka muqabla woh na kar sakenge, aur hum unhein aisi zillat ke saath wahan se nikalenge ke woh khwar hokar reh jayenge”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: Then he said, ‘Counsellors, which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?’
Sulaiman ne kaha “aey ehle darbaar, tum mein se kaun uska takht (throne) mere paas laata hai qabl iske ke woh log mutii (farmabardaar) hokar mere paas haazir hoon?”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌ

translations.text: A powerful and crafty jinn replied, ‘I will bring it to you before you can even rise from your place. I am strong and trustworthy enough,’
Jinno mein se ek qawi (mighty) haykal ne arz kiya “ main usey haazir kardunga qabl iske ke aap apni jagah se utthein. Main iski taaqat rakhta hoon aur amaanatdaar hoon”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّ كَرِيمٌ

translations.text: but one of them who had some knowledge of the Scripture said, ‘I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.’ When Solomon saw it set before him, he said, ‘This is a favour from my Lord, to test whether I am grateful or not: if anyone is grateful, it is for his own good, if anyone is ungrateful, then my Lord is self-sufficient and most generous.’

Jis shaks ke paas kitaab ka ilam tha woh bola “main aapki palakh jhapakne se pehle usey laye deta hoon”. Junhi ke Sulaiman ne woh takht apne paas rakkha hua dekha, woh pukar uttha “Yeh mere Rub ka fazal hai taa-ke woh mujhey aazmaaye ke main shukar karta hoon ya kaafir e niyamat karta hoon. Aur jo koi shukar karta hai uska shukar uske apne hi liye mufeed hai, warna koi nashukari karey to mera Rubb be-niyaz aur apni zaat mein aap buzurg hai.”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: Then he said, ‘Disguise her throne, and we shall see whether or not she recognizes it.’
Sulaiman ne kaha “anjaan tareeqe se uska takht uske saamne rakh do, dekhein woh saheeh baat tak pahunchti hai ya un logon mein se hai jo raah e raast nahin paatey.”

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: When she arrived, she was asked, ‘Is this your throne?’ She replied, ‘It looks like it.’ [Solomon said], ‘We were given knowledge before her, and we devoted ourselves to God;

Malika jab haazir hui to ussey kaha gaya, kya tera takht (throne) aisa hi hai? Woh kehne lagi “yeh to goya wahi hai , hum to pehle hi jaan gaye thay aur humne sar-e-itaat jhuka diya tha (ya hum muslim ho chuke thay)”

verses.text_uthmani: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَـٰفِرِينَ

translations.text: she was prevented by what she worshipped instead of God, for she came from a disbelieving people.’
Usko (iman laney se) jis cheez ne rok rakkha tha woh un maboodon ki ibadat thi jinhein woh Allah ke siwa poojhti thi, kyunke woh ek kafir qaum se thi

verses.text_uthmani: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: Then it was said to her, ‘Enter the hall,’ but when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pool of water, and bared her legs. Solomon explained, ‘It is just a hall paved with glass,’ and she said, ‘My Lord, I have wronged myself: I devote myself, with Solomon, to God, the Lord of the Worlds.’

Ussey kaha gaya ke mahal mein daakhil ho, usne jo dekha to samjhi ke pani ka hauz hai aur utarne ke liye usne apne painchey utha liye (tucked up her skirt) , Sulaiman ne kaha yeh sheeshey (glass) ka chikna farsh hai ispar woh pukar utthi “Aey mere Rubb, (aaj tak) main apne nafs par bada zulm karti rahi, aur ab maine Sulaiman ke saath Allah Rabbul aalameen ki itaat qabool karli”

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

translations.text: To the people of Thamud We sent their brother, Salih, saying, ‘Worship God alone,’ but they split into two rival factions.
Aur Samood ki taraf humne unke bhai Saleh ko (yeh paigaam de kar) bheja ke Allah ki bandagi karo, to yakayak woh do mutakhasim fareeq (two wrangling) ban gaye

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

translations.text: Salih said, ‘My people, why do you rush to bring [forward] what is bad rather than good? Why do you not ask forgiveness of God, so that you may be given mercy?’
Saleh ne kaha “aey meri qaum ke logon, bhalayi se pehle burayi ke liye kyun jaldi machate ho? Kyun nahin Allah se magfirat talab karte? Shayad ke tumpar reham farmaya jaye?”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَـٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ

translations.text: They said, ‘We see you and your fol-lowers as an evil omen.’ He replied, ‘God will decide on any omen you may see: you people are being put to the test.’

Unhon ne kaha “humne to tumko aur tumhare sathiyon ko badd-shaguni ka nishaan paya hai”. Saleh ne jawab diya “tumhare neik o badd shagun ka sar rishta (good and bad omens issue) Allah ke paas hai. Asal baat yeh hai ke tum logon ki aazmaish ho rahi hai”

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

translations.text: There were nine men in the city who spread corruption in the land without making amends.
Us shehar mein naw (nine) jatthey-daar (ring-leaders) thay jo mulk mein fasaad phaylatey aur koi islaah ka kaam na karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ

translations.text: They said, ‘Swear by God: we shall attack this man and his household in the night, then say to his next of kin, “We did not witness the destruction of his household. We are telling the truth.”’

Unhon ne aapas mein kaha “ khuda ki kasam kha kar ahad karlo ke hum Saleh aur uske ghar walon par shabkhun (secret night attack) marenge aur phir uske wali(guardian) se keh denge ke hum us khandaan ki halakat ke mauqe par maujood na thay, hum bilkul sach kehte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.text: So they devised their evil plan, but We too made a plan of which they were unaware.
Yeh chaal to woh chale aur phir ek chaal humne chali jiski unhein khabar na thi

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: See how their scheming ended: We destroyed them utterly, along with all their people.
Ab dekhlo ke unki chaal ka anjaam kya hua. Humne tabaah karke rakh diya unko aur unki poori qaum ko

verses.text_uthmani: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: As a result of their evil deeds, their homes are desolate ruins- there truly is a sign in this for those who know-
Woh unke ghar khali padey hain us zulm ki padash mein jo woh karte thay, Is mein ek nishaan e ibrat hai un logon ke liye jo ilm rakhte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ

translations.text: but We saved those who believed and were mindful of God.
Aur bacha liya humne un logon ko jo iman laye thay aur nafarmani se parheiz karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.text: We also sent Lot to his people. He said to them, ‘How can you commit this outrage with your eyes wide open?
Aur Lut ko humne bheja. Yaad karo woh waqt jab usne apni qaum se kaha “kya tum aankhon dekhte badhkari karte ho

verses.text_uthmani: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ

translations.text: How can you lust after men instead of women? What fools you are!’
Kya tumhara yahi chalan hai ke auraton ko chodh kar mardon ke paas shehwat-rani (sexual desire) ke liye jatey ho? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tumlog sakht jahalat(ignorance) ka kaam karte ho.”

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ

translations.text: The only answer his people gave was to say, ‘Expel Lot’s followers from your town! These men mean to stay chaste!’
Magar uski qaum ka jawab iske siwa kuch na tha ke unhon ne kaha “ nikaal do Lut ke ghar walon ko apni basti se, yeh baday paakbaaz bante hain”

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَـٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

translations.text: We saved him and his family- except for his wife: We made her stay behind-
Aakhir e kaar humne bacha liya usko aur uske ghar walon ko, bajuz uski biwi ke jiska peechey reh jana humne tai kardiya tha

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

translations.text: and We brought rain down on them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been warned!
Aur barsayi un logon par ek barsaat, bahut hi buri barsaat thi wo un logon ke haqq mein jo mutanabbeh kiye jaa chuke thay

verses.text_uthmani: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: Say [Prophet], ‘Praise be to God and peace on the servants He has chosen. Who is better: God, or those they set up as partners with Him?
(Aey Nabi) kaho, hamd hai Allah ke liye aur salaam uske un bandon par jinhein usne barguzida kiya. (Insey pucho) Allah behtar hai ya woh mabood jinhein yeh log iska shareek bana rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ

translations.text: Who created the heavens and earth? Who sends down water from the sky for you- with which We cause gardens of delight to grow: you have no power to make the trees grow in them- is it another god beside God? No! But they are people who take others to be equal with God.

Bhala woh kaun hai jisne aasmano aur zameen ko paida kiya, aur tumhare liye aasmaan se pani barsaya, phir uske zariye se woh khusnuma baagh ugaye jinke darakhton ka ugana tumhare bas mein na tha? Kya Allah ke saath koi dusra khuda bhi (in kaamon mein shareek) hai? (Nahin), balke yahi log raah e raast se hatkar chale jaa rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَـٰلَهَآ أَنْهَـٰرًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: Who is it that made the earth a stable place to live? Who made rivers flow through it? Who set immovable mountains on it and created a barrier between the fresh and salt water? Is it another god beside God? No! But most of them do not know.

Aur woh kaun hai jisne zameen ko jaye qaraar banaya aur uske andar dariya rawan kiye, aur usmein (pahadon ki) mekhein gaadh di aur pani ke do zakhiron(two bodies) ke darmiyan purda hayal kardiye? Kya Allah ke saath koi aur khuda bhi (in kaamon mein shareek) hai? Nahin, balke in mein se aksar log nadaan hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: Who is it that answers the distressed when they call upon Him? Who removes their suffering? Who makes you successors in the earth? Is it another god beside God? Little notice you take!

Kaun hai jo bekarar ki dua sunta hai jabke woh usey pukare aur kaun uski takleef rafaa karta hai? Aur (kaun hai jo) tumhein zameen ka khalifa banata hai? Kya Allah ke saath koi aur khuda bhi (yeh kaam karne wala) hai? Tum log kam hi sochte ho

verses.text_uthmani: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ تَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: Who is it that guides you through the darkness on land and sea? Who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His mercy? Is it another god beside God? God is far above the partners they put beside him!

Aur woh kaun hai jo khushki aur samandar ki tareekiyon (darkness) mein tumko raasta dikhata hai aur kaun apni rehmat ke aagey hawaon ko khush khabri lekar bhejhta hai? Kya Allah ke saath koi dusra khuda bhi (yeh kaam karta) hai? Bahut baala o bartar hai Allah us shirk se jo yeh log karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

translations.text: Who is it that creates life and reproduces it? Who is it that gives you provision from the heavens and earth? Is it another god beside God?’ Say, ‘Show me your evidence then, if what you say is true.’

Aur woh kaun hai jo khalq (creation) ki ibtida (orignate) karta aur phir uska iaada (reproduce) karta hai. Aur kaun tumko aasmaan aur zameen se rizq deta hai? Kya Allah ke saath koi aur khuda bhi (in kaamon mein hissedar) hai? Kaho ke laao apni daleel agar tum sachhey ho

verses.text_uthmani: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.text: Say, ‘No one in the heavens or on earth knows the unseen except God.’ They do not know when they will be raised from the dead:
Inse kaho, Allah ke siwa aasmano aur zameen mein koi gaib ka ilam nahin rakhta, aur woh nahin jaante ke kab woh uthaye jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ

translations.text: their knowledge cannot comprehend the Hereafter; they are in doubt about it; they are blind to it.
Balke aakhirat ka to ilam hi in logon se ghum ho gaya hai, balke yeh uski taraf se shakk mein hain, balke yeh ussey andhey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ

translations.text: So the disbelievers say, ‘What! When we and our forefathers have become dust, shall we be brought back to life again?
Yeh munkireen kehte hain “kya jab hum aur hamare baap dada mitti ho chuke honge to humein waqayi qabaron se nikala jayega?”

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
Yeh khabrein humko bhi bahut di gayi hain aur pehle hamare aabaa o ajdaad ko bhi di jaati rahi hain, magar yeh bas afsane hi afsane hain jo agle waqton se sunte chale aa rahey hain”

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.text: [Prophet], say, ‘Travel through the earth and see how the evildoers ended up.’
Kaho, zara zameen mein chal phir kar dekho ke mujreemo ka kya anjaam ho chuka hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

translations.text: [Prophet], do not grieve over them; do not be distressed by their schemes.
(Aey Nabi), inke haal par ranjh na karo aur na inki chaalon par dil tangg ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

translations.text: They also say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled if what you say is true?’
Woh kehte hain ke “yeh dhamki kab poori hogi agar tum sacchey ho?”

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

translations.text: Say, ‘Maybe some of what you seek to hasten is near at hand.’
Kaho, kya ajab ke jis azaab ke liye tum jaldi macha rahey ho uska ek hissa tumhare qareeb hi aa laga ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

translations.text: Your Lord is bountiful to people, though most of them are ungrateful.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tera Rubb to logon par bada fazal farmane wala hai, magar aksar log shukar nahin karte

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

translations.text: He knows everything their hearts conceal and everything they reveal:
Bila shubha tera Rubb khoob jaanta hai jo kuch unke seenay apne andar chupaye huey hain aur jo kuch woh zaahir karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: there is nothing hidden in the heavens or on earth that is not in a clear Record.
Aasmaan o zameen ki koi posheeda cheez aisi nahin hai jo ek wazeh kitaab mein likhi hui maujood na ho

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

translations.text: Truly, this Quran explains to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about,
Yeh waqia hai ke yeh Quraan bani Israel ko aksar un baaton ki haqeeqat batata hai jin mein woh ikhtilaf rakhte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: and it is guidance and grace for those who believe.
Aur yeh hidayat aur rehmat hai iman laney walon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: Truly, your Lord will judge between them in His wisdom- He is the Almighty, the All Knowing-
Yaqeenan (isi tarah) tera Rubb in logon ke darmiyan bhi apne hukum se faisla kardega. Aur woh zabardast aur sab kuch jaan-nay wala hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ

translations.text: so [Prophet], put your trust in God, you are on the path of clear truth.
Pas aey Nabi, Allah par bharosa rakkho, yaqeenan tum sareeh haqq par ho

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ

translations.text: You cannot make the dead hear, you cannot make the deaf listen to your call when they turn their backs and leave,
Tum murdon ko nahin suna sakte, na un behron tak apni pukar pahuncha sakte ho jo peeth phair kar bhaagey ja rahey hon

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِى ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

translations.text: you cannot guide the blind out of their error: you cannot make anyone hear you except those who believe in Our signs and submit [to Us].
Aur na andhon ko raasta bata kar bhatakne se bacha sakte ho. Tum to apni baat unhi logon ko suna sakte ho jo hamari aayat par iman latey hain aur phir farmabardaar ban jatey hain

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ

translations.text: When the verdict is given against them, We shall bring a creature out of the earth, which will tell them that people had no faith in Our revelations.
Aur jab hamari baat poori hone ka waqt unpar aa pahunchega to hum unke liye ek jaanwar zameen se nikalenge jo unse kalaam karega ke log hamari aayat par yaqeen nahin karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

translations.text: The Day will come when We gather from every community a crowd of those who disbelieved in Our signs and they will be led in separate groups

Aur zara tasavvur karo us din ka jab hum har ummat mein se ek fauj ki fauj un logon ki gher layenge jo hamari aayat ko jhutlaya karte thay, phir unko (unki aqsaam (classification and merit) ke lihaz se darja ba darja) murattab (arrange) kiya jayega

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا۟ بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: until, when they come before Him, He will say, ‘Did you deny My messages without even taking them in? Or what were you doing?’
Yahan tak ke jab sab aa jayenge to (unka Rubb unse) puchega ke “tumne meri aayat ko jhutla diya halaanke tumne unka ilmi ihata (comprehend) na kiya tha? Agar yeh nahin to aur tum kya kar rahey thay?”

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

translations.text: The verdict will be given against them because of their wrongdoing: they will not speak.
Aur unke zulm ki wajah se azaab ka wada unpar poora ho jayega, tab woh kuch bhi na bol sakenge

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: Did they not see that We gave them the night for rest, and the day for light? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
Kya unko soojhayi na deta tha ke humne raat unke liye sukoon haasil karne ko banayi thi aur din ko roshan kiya tha? Isi mein bahut nishaniyan thi un logon ke liye jo iman latey thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ

translations.text: On the Day the Trumpet sounds, everyone in heaven and on earth will be terrified- except such as God wills- and all will come to Him in utter humility.

Aur kya guzregi us roz jabke sur/soor (trumphet) phunka jaayega aur haul(terror) kha jayenge woh sab jo aasmaano aur zameen mein hain, siwaye un logon ke jinhein Allah is haul(terror) se bachana chahega. Aur sab kaan dabaye uske huzoor hazir ho jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ

translations.text: You will see the mountains and think they are firmly fixed, but they will float away like clouds: this is the handiwork of God who has perfected all things. He is fully aware of what you do:

Aaj tu pahadon ko dekhta hai aur samajhta hai ke khoob jamey huey hain, magar us waqt yeh baadalon ki tarah udh rahey honge, yeh Allah ki qudrat ka karishma hoga jisne har cheez ko hikmat ke saath ustwar (ordered with wisdom) kiya hai. Woh khoob jaanta hai ke tumlog kya karte ho

verses.text_uthmani: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ

translations.text: whoever comes with a good deed will be rewarded with something better, and be secure from the terrors of that Day,
Jo shaks bhalayi lekar aayega usey ussey zyada behtar sila milega aur aisey log us din ke haul (terror/dehshat) se mehfooz hongey

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: but whoever comes with evil deeds will be cast face downwards into the Fire. ‘Are you rewarded for anything except what you have done?’
Aur jo burayi liye huey aayega, aisey sab log aundhey mooh aag mein phenke jayenge. Kya tumlog iske siwa koi aur jaza paa sakte ho ke jaisa karo waisa bharo

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: [Say Prophet], ‘What I am commanded to do is to serve the Sustainer of this town, which He has made inviolable. Everything belongs to Him; I am commanded to be one of those devoted to Him;

(Aey Muhammad, Insey kaho) “Mujhey to yahi hukum diya gaya hai ke is shehar ke Rubb ki bandagi karoon jisne isey haram (sacred) banaya hai, aur jo har cheez ka maalik hai. Mujhey hukum diya gaya hai ke main Muslim ban kar rahoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ

translations.text: I am commanded to recite the Quran.’ Whoever chooses to follow the right path does so for his own good. Say to whoever deviates from it, ‘I am only here to warn.’
Aur yeh Quran padh kar sunaoon” ab jo hidayat ikhtiyar karega woh apne hi bhale ke liye hidayat ikhtiyar karega, aur jo gumraah ho ussey kehdo main to bas khabardaar kardene wala hoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: Say, ‘Praise belongs to God: He will show you His signs so that you will recognize them.’ Your Lord is never unmindful of what you all do.
Insey kaho, tareef Allah hi ke liye hai, ankareeb woh tumhein apni nishaniyan dikha dega aur tum unhein pehchan logey, aur tera Rubb bay-khabar nahin hai un aamal se jo tum log karte ho
